H_hierarchical.evidence: The flowchart is divided into 'mode masuk' and 'mode keluar', but the paper does not define explicit nested parent/child states.

G_guards_arith.evidence: Memory 220.02 is enabled by a combined guard: mode masuk, RFID/HMI-derived room selection, and target-room photodiode vacancy.

A_actions_nontrivial.evidence: The HMI writes an empty-room value to the database/PLC input, PLC memory is activated, and motors, gate, indicators, and full-message outputs are driven.

F_fault_recovery.evidence: No emergency-stop, fault rollback, abort-from-any-state, or recovery path is described; PB Stop is only listed as an input.

T1_cross_section_element.evidence: Mode inputs are in the PLC I/O table, RFID/empty-room logic is in the Visual Studio section, and the 220.02 guard/action plus gate sequence appear later in system testing.

T2_implicit_domain_term.evidence: Domain terms such as Mode Masuk, Mode Keluar, and Indikator Penuh are accompanied by explicit behavior rather than requiring outside-domain rule decoding.

T3_implicit_action_from_prose.evidence: The plate retrieval and gate-lowering actions are described narratively in the testing section, not co-located with the mode or I/O definitions.

T4_multivar_arith_guard.evidence: The entry memory guard combines mode masuk, RFID/HMI direction, and target-room photodiode vacancy.

T5_composite_internal_behavior.evidence: No composite parent state with its own entry/during/exit behavior is specified.

T6_global_cross_cutting_recovery.evidence: The full-parking condition blocks new entry selection, but the paper does not declare a from-any-state fault or recovery transition.

C1_speculative_dfs.evidence: No deep composite state or non-trivial init/pseudo-state chain is present.

C2_expr_ir_smt.evidence: There is one main boolean-composed guard around entry-memory activation, but not three or more SMT-worthy arithmetic/boolean guards.

C3_forced_and_aspect.evidence: No cross-cutting transition over three or more substates and no parent-level continuous monitor is described.

C4_abstract_action.evidence: The model includes HMI/database notification and record-update side effects, although most outputs are concrete PLC motors, relays, and indicators.

key_nl_quotes: Syarat untuk mengaktifkan memory ini adalah dengan menekan mode masuk, dan pengarahan dari hasil pembacaan tag RFID oleh visual studio.
Apabila sensor tidak mendeteksi mobil dalam kamar yang dituju, maka mobil dapat masuk.
Sistem akan mengambil plat dari kamar yang dituju terlebih dahulu dan setelah plat telah mencapai lantai dasar, maka gerbang akan turun sebagai jembatan.
one_line_pitch: A compact PLC parking controller whose entry behavior requires joining RFID/database selection, multivariable vacancy guards, and electromechanical plate-gate actions scattered across several paper sections.
rationale: This is a meaningful guard/action stress test because the entry workflow combines RFID identity, HMI/database slot selection, PLC memory activation, target-room vacancy sensing, and sequenced motor/gate outputs. It also has high baseline-trap density because state names, guards, and actions are split across I/O tables, HMI design, and system-test prose. However, it lacks explicit hierarchy and fault recovery, so it is better as a backup sample than a top all-around candidate.
